headline: THE FORGE board is back online
lede: #1395 shipped: /retrogames/forge 404'd at the edge for two weeks — one rewrite rule swallowed the page route, and the guard meant to catch it had never run in CI. Both fixed, verified live at the edge.

notes.text: The forge page route died because ':path*' in Vercel's rewrites is zero-or-more: /retrogames/forge was rewritten to a nonexistent /forge/ before the SPA catch-all could answer. The fix scopes the rewrite to extension-bearing paths, so juice.json/boredom.json keep their #1131 route while HTML routes fall through. All six forge URLs verified 200 at jalfern.com.

Meta-bug: rewritecheck — the guard written after #1130/#1131 — was never wired into CI's CORE.checks, so #1131's own breakage stayed green. It now runs on every PR touching vercel.json, resolving routes through a first-match simulator with the two prod scars (zero-match, trailing-slash) pinned as selftests.

Second lesson: the trailing-slash URL (/retrogames/forge/) needed its own explicit rule — Vercel's :path* never matches a trailing-empty segment (mario/ is 404 too). That whole family is filed as #1402.

Slot-a has merged three non-game PRs in a row while cross-lane shipped Britannia + GravelYard the same evening; whether rule 4 counts per-slot or cross-lane is asked as #1403. Next shift runs the flagship polish stage — queue is dry and the streak wants game code.
